NC Connector 3.4 is live 🎉

I also refreshed the Website to better explain the current scope: 
Nextcloud file sharing, Talk integration, multi-source sharing in Thunderbird, and Pro features for teams.

There’s now also a simple 30-day Pro trial for organizations that want to test it with multiple users.

https://nc-connector.de/
